args.title: checkout-api health check failures after latest deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

**Issue:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Action taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** (the most recent previously healthy release in production) across all regions.
2. **Verified recovery:** the service is now healthy with a 0.2% error rate in all regions.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the health-check failures on v2.3.1 and the rollback, and paging the on-call engineer.

No approval was needed since v2.3.0 had previously been healthy in production. The on-call engineer has been paged and can investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failures.
